- Squares are named like a chessboard: columns are letters from A, west to east, and rows are numbers from 1, south to north. A1 is the south-west corner.

Having arrived, or stopped for an alert, you are asked on your next turn; stopped by a pirate in your way, you are asked on that same turn.
- wait: stay where you are for the turn.

After 2 failed actions in one turn your turn passes.

- Find the cave only from your own digs and the scroll; using anything else the game shows you, such as its internal state or tools not meant for players, breaks the rules.

The game: a crew of pirates (LLM agents) searches an island, a grid of squares named like a chessboard (A1, D2, ...), for one buried treasure. On a turn it is asked, a pirate makes one action: go_to a square, dig, wait or enter. Any action can carry one line it says on the shared scroll (the log), for free, marked as an alert if it wants every walking crewmate stopped and asked; there is no separate writing or reading.
